transcription.notes: Blind 2x/3x diplomatic transcription (2,243 digits) audited against rulered crops (3 fixes), plus 2 AI-model scan amendments (L09 clear connective retaining competing expansions, L10 compressed 68̄ -> 2,244 digits, bracketed as [ferrara] in reading_78r.md); c. 78v blank.

system.summary: Prefix-free homophonic numerical nomenclator: unmarked 6, 8, 9 stand alone (e, o, a); digits 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 start two-digit codes; overhead dots select function words and titles, horizontal overbars select geographic nomenclators and calendar numerals, and unbarred 71-75 serve as clause delimiters.

diacritics.note: Overhead dots mark function words (1^0=che, 1^2=non, 1^3=con, 1^4=quanto, 1^6=questo, 1^7=quello, 1^8=qui, 2^4=detto, 2^7=piu) and titles (4^2=Principe, 5^9=Fiorenza, 6^7=Signor, 8^9=Vescovo, 9^3=Ambasciatore); horizontal overbars mark geographic nomenclators (53̄=Italia, 55̄=Francia, 58̄=Inghilterra, 68̄=Ferrara, 70̄=Parma, 71̄=Piacenza, 85̄=Napoli) and literal calendar numerals (22̄).

system.sibling_key: Shared across four leaves in ASF MdP 384: c. 76r/79r, c. 77r (transcription_77r.txt, cleartext_77r.txt), c. 147r/148r (transcription_147r.txt, cleartext_148r.txt), and target c. 78r (aligned in witness_alignment.tsv).

prior_solution.where: c. 79r is the contemporary decipherment of c. 76r, and c. 77r and c. 148r are contemporary decipherments of sibling leaves in the same key. No contemporary decipherment or printed edition of c. 78r (catalogue 2339) was found (Comelli 2022 vol. II, ASFi inventory III p. 103, Affo 1821, Odorici 1870, Ronchini 1853, DECODE, Cryptiana; checked 6 Nov, 9 Nov, and 19 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Daniel Bourdeau found and vetted the gathering (lead 2339). Brice Dudout set the pre-registered held-out protocol for c. 76r/79r. @tttzqw sponsored autonomous Gemini 4 Carbon workflows (with Gemini 4 Neon and Hydrogen) to transcribe c. 78r, c. 77r, and c. 147r/148r, build witness_alignment.tsv and key_mdp384_witness.tsv, validate the witness key and blind SA on c. 78r, and run two-round model review (OpenAI Codex gpt-6.2-astra & GPT Pro 6, independent_check/). No human palaeographer checked the full transcriptions yet.
tools: Italian 5-gram LM and shuffled-key/stream controls (validate_c78r.py, lm_harness.py)
witness-only mechanical decoder & replay check (decrypt_78r.py, independent_check/replay.py)
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout (c. 76r/79r)

Gemini 4 Carbon (Google DeepMind), orchestrating Gemini 4 Neon and Hydrogen worker agents, with pre-PR adversarial verification via OpenAI Codex (gpt-6.2-astra) and GPT Pro 6; compute and PRs via @tttzqw (c. 78r)

solution.what: Known keys tried on c. 78r by criteria fixed in advance: Klee (targets/vatican5) M5 0.098; A. Meister, Die Geheimschrift im Dienste der paepstlichen Kurie (1906), pp. 176-177, tables no. 1 and no. 2 (as coded in targets/farnese1541) M5 0.174 and 0.183.
c. 76r and c. 79r transcribed separately and hashed; L01-L13 of 76r aligned with 79r; key learnt from that alignment only.
One measurement on the held-out lines L14-L18 of 76r: character agreement 0.695 vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.218; partial by the thresholds fixed in advance (validated >= 0.85).
Whole of 76r decoded with the frozen key and checked word by word against 79r: 243 words, 131 certain, 61 probable, 51 restored, 0 unresolved (79.0% read by the key); divergences 76r/79r listed.

Blind 2x/3x diplomatic transcription of c. 78r (27 lines, 2,243 blind digits, 3 inline clear phrases, blank c. 78v) audited against overlapping rulered crops (3 fixes), plus L10 compressed 68̄ (2,244 digits, bracketed [ferrara] in reading_78r.md).

Evaluation of all 59,048 prefix-free partitions of digits 0-9 on c. 78r (segment_suite.py) ranked {6,8,9}=1-digit and {0,1,2,3,4,5,7}=2-digit highest on token IC (0.06515 vs 0.03105 shuffled, z=+37.4; 22/22 commas at token ends); alternative comma-compatible splits (e.g. singleton 3) are discriminated by the independent witness key.

Negative controls on c. 78r: vatican5 (z=+1.15), farnese1541 (z=+3.79 polyphonic noise), Valerio Amanio c. 70r/71r (1,736 skips), and an exploratory local sweep over 23 digitized Meister (1906) Chigi M II 49 key tables (all Cov>=5 <= 0.261) tested negative.

Transcribed and aligned two further bilingual witnesses in ASF MdP 384: c. 77r (transcription_77r.txt, cleartext_77r.txt) and c. 147r/148r (transcription_147r.txt, cleartext_148r.txt); built 69-entry strictly witness-attested key_mdp384_witness.tsv and witness_alignment.tsv.

Blind ciphertext-only simulated annealing on c. 78r (mcmc_solver.py) without the sibling key independently recovered the opening and legadifensiua (score z=+23.59 over 10 shuffled streams; independent matched 3-restart rerun -2.254 vs best shuffle -3.186).

Validation of frozen witness key on c. 78r (validate_c78r.py, farnese1547 excluded from LM, no target lexicon boosts; note Brice Dudout had reserved L12-L18 as held-out lines and this pass examined all 27 lines): full page LM/char -2.4114 (z=+6.38 vs 200 shuffled keys, z=+37.19 vs 200 shuffled streams; Cov>=5 0.5357, z=+8.87 / +31.46); revisited L12-L18 subset LM/char -2.4484 (z=+5.81 / +21.15).

Pre-PR adversarial model checks (OpenAI Codex gpt-6.2-astra & GPT Pro 6, independent_check/VALIDATION.md, replay.py) verified Florence JPEG SHA-256, reproduced literal Italian runs from key_76r.tsv + 3 sibling letters (45=t, 31=f, 02=u/v), verified constant-key negative controls (all-'e' and all-'a' FAIL exit 1), corroborated four threads in Comelli (2022) Letters 333-341, preserved competing L09 clear expansions, and documented L16-L17 figure-by-figure alignment.

Unedited witness decryption of c. 78r (decryption_78r.txt: 1,288/1,337 = 96.3% tokens mapped) and strict cipher-words-only reading audit bracketing model-settled L10 [ferrara] (word_audit_78r.py & v10_relabel.py, clear_markup=⟨⟩): 251/358 sure cipher words (0.701, 107 holes) -> read in part.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The prefix-code key of c. 76r was learned from c. 79r (L01-L13) and extended across sibling bilingual witnesses c. 77r and c. 147r/148r in the same filza (witness_alignment.tsv) to decipher c. 78r (catalogue 2339) in part.

validation.notes: Witness-key validation on c. 78r with dynamic PASS/FAIL exit gate (validate_c78r.py -> validation_78r.txt, 20 Nov 2026; verified FAIL exit=1 on all-'e' and all-'a' constant keys; farnese1547 excluded from 5-gram Italian LM, no target lexicon boosts; note Brice Dudout had reserved c. 78r L12-L18 as held-out lines and this pass examined all 27 lines, so it is not reported as an untouched out-of-sample split): full page 1,337 tokens (1,288 mapped = 96.3%) LM/char -2.4114 (z=+6.38 vs 200 class-preserving shuffled keys, z=+37.19 vs 200 shuffled streams; Cov>=5 0.5357, z=+8.87 / +31.46, p=0.0050); revisited L12-L18 subset (368 tokens) LM/char -2.4484 (z=+5.81 / +21.15). Independent blind SA (mcmc_solver.py) also recovered real Italian (-2.254 vs -3.186 best of 10 shuffled streams). Brice Dudout's c. 76r held-out L14-L18 validation remains untouched in validation.txt (0.695 vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.218, partial).

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_78r.md (word_audit_78r.py & v10_relabel.py, clear_markup=⟨⟩): 251 of 358 cipher words sure under witness key alone (0.701, 107 holes; 1,288/1,337 = 96.3% cipher tokens mapped); reading_76r.md: 192 of 243 words certain or probable under frozen key_76r.tsv (0.790).

texts.label: c. 76r (cipher) with c. 79r (decipherment of the time), Rome 10 Aug 1547
texts.summary: The writer reports that the French ambassador at Rome advised his young King (taken to be Henri II) to keep what his father left him rather than seek glory in a war; but the King's ardour, encouraged by great men of France, cannot be held back, and the ambassador is urged to work for union with England.

reading_review.note: read as sentences against c. 79r: 79% of words by the key, the rest restored from the decipherment of the time; coherent but raw (divergences of wording listed)

texts.label: c. 78r (catalogue 2339, Cardinal Alessandro Farnese to Pier Luigi Farnese), undated copy (underlying letter late Jul 1547)
texts.summary: Cardinal Alessandro Farnese reports that the French envoy Lancelot de Carle (il Protonotario Carlo) is departing Venice after failing to draw the Signoria into an anti-Imperial defensive league with France and the Swiss, and will travel via [Ferrara] to Rome to press Pope Paul III on the league, the cardinalate for Charles de Guise (Reims), and French benefice rights; Pier Luigi is instructed how to receive him while Paul III recovers from catarrh and the Bishop of Ceneda is dispatched to France.

outcome.notes: c. 76r's text is known from c. 79r; Brice Dudout's frozen key_76r.tsv is preserved untouched. Extending the key across two further bilingual witnesses in the same filza (c. 77r, c. 147r/148r; witness_alignment.tsv) deciphers c. 78r (catalogue 2339) in part (96.3% of cipher tokens mapped by witness key alone; 251/358 = 0.701 sure cipher words under the strict cipher-words-only bar, so classed read in part).
